text_block_list.text: One day during training with Vivlos――

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... Haaah~?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...
feels kind of off today?
Body feels super heavy.
Couldn't quite catch my rhythm at all~.
choice_data_list: Then, let's call it a day

text_block_list.text:
If she felt off,
pushing harder wasn't wise.
I wondered what was causing it...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah, nothing's physically wrong with me
though!
At times like this, you see~

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
There's only one cure♡
C'mon, Tore-cchi, let's go, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Kyaa~ so cute!
This is another new drop, right♡?

text_block_list.name: Shop Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Yes♪ These ear cuffs double as rings,
and match beautifully with the other items
in this line!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
No way, no way, that sounds ultra cute!
Onee-san, could you wrap up both for me♪?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Tore-cchi, pick something to match this!
Everything looks so good,
I totally can't decide, you know?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's check out clothes next!
Which looks cutest?
Maybe those white shorts and that pink
pleated mini♪?

text_block_list.name: Shop Clerk
text_block_list.text:
That pleated mini skirt just arrived today!
The fabric is very
durable,
so you can wear it straight through early
autumn♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, gotcha!
Grabbing this then♪ In that case,
need a top to pair with it!
Which ones are brand new?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Phew~~ that was insanely fun!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Scored tons of new cute stuff.
Yep, tomorrow I'll be 100% full energy♪
choice_data_list: It was all new stuff wasn't it?
It was all new stuff wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Because getting hyped makes everything
better!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
That excitement gets me feeling so
incredible!
Like I can do literally anything♡ vibes like
that~

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehe♡ Tomorrow I'll show you the power of
that hype, Tore-cchi♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Haa――haa――!
...Not yet, not yet,
still got plenty more in me~~~~~~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ――Wheeee~~~! Did you see that, Tore-cchi?!
choice_data_list: So that was the power of 『Exciteme...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Told you so♡ I'm so full of hype
I can blaze through like whoooosh!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehe! If I keep riding this wave of pure
excitement, someday――

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I'll definitely make it all the way to
Dubai!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
All dazzling sparkly!
Pure super celeb vibes!
A glittering dream that never fades...
that very world!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
For that I need more... way, way moooore!
Gotta keep giving my best fueled by this
excitement!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
That's right! So Tore-cchi,
you gotta reaaally help keep my hype up――

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Hm? Got a notification... Ah.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah――! No way!
That shop from yesterday just dropped another
new item!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
How much training is left today?
I'll blaze through it,
so come shopping with me after!
Pretty please?

All for Vivlos' dream and motivation.
Keeping her "Excitement" high was going to
be the key.
